**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Pure Mathematics with Mechanics Paper 2 (0765/2), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2024. Time allowed: three hours.**

Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae booklets published by the Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Start each question on a fresh page.

questions.enonce_markdown:
The parametric equations of a curve are given by

$$x = 1 + t, \qquad y = 2 + \frac{1}{t}, \qquad t \neq 0 \text{ is a parameter.}$$

Show that an equation of the normal to the curve at the point where $t = 2$ is $8x - 2y - 19 = 0$.

Find the value of $t$ at the point where this normal meets the curve again. (6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Gradient.** $\dfrac{dx}{dt} = 1$ and $\dfrac{dy}{dt} = -\dfrac{1}{t^2}$, so

$$\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt} = -\frac{1}{t^2}.$$

At $t = 2$: the point is $(1 + 2,\ 2 + \tfrac12) = \left(3, \tfrac52\right)$ and the tangent gradient is $-\dfrac14$. The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so its gradient is the negative reciprocal, $4$.

**Normal.**

$$y - \frac52 = 4(x - 3) \;\Longrightarrow\; 2y - 5 = 8x - 24 \;\Longrightarrow\; 8x - 2y - 19 = 0. \qquad \blacksquare$$

**Second intersection.** A point of the curve with parameter $t$ is on the normal when

$$8(1 + t) - 2\left(2 + \frac1t\right) - 19 = 0 \;\Longrightarrow\; 8t - 15 - \frac{2}{t} = 0 \;\Longrightarrow\; 8t^2 - 15t - 2 = 0.$$

Factorise: $(t - 2)(8t + 1) = 0$. The root $t = 2$ is the given point; the other root is

$$\boxed{t = -\tfrac18}$$

(The point is $\left(\tfrac78, -6\right)$. Check: $8\cdot\tfrac78 - 2(-6) - 19 = 7 + 12 - 19 = 0$.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
A new primary school intends to recruit a head teacher and $7$ other teachers. There are $3$ male and $2$ female applicants for the position of head teacher, $4$ male and $6$ female other applications for the teaching positions.

Find the number of different ways of selecting the staff of $8$ if gender equity must be respected. (7 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Interpretation.** Gender equity means the staff of $8$ (head teacher included) contains $4$ men and $4$ women. The head teacher is chosen among the $5$ head-teacher applicants; the $7$ other teachers are chosen among the $10$ other applicants ($4$ male, $6$ female). The two selections are independent.

**Case 1: the head teacher is male.** There are $3$ choices. The $7$ other teachers must then contain $3$ men and $4$ women:

$$3 \times \binom{4}{3}\binom{6}{4} = 3 \times 4 \times 15 = 180.$$

**Case 2: the head teacher is female.** There are $2$ choices. The $7$ other teachers must then contain $4$ men and $3$ women:

$$2 \times \binom{4}{4}\binom{6}{3} = 2 \times 1 \times 20 = 40.$$

The cases are exclusive, so add:

$$\boxed{180 + 40 = 220 \text{ different ways}}$$
